added_failures_note: Both arms were read from the reviewed run's own gate logs: baseline_suite (c323401f, EXIT=0, completed, 0 failures) and after_suite (ca823b29b, EXIT=0, completed, 0 failures) in run dir r-20261005T084026008625-delete-graph-client-slurm-duplicate. No test fails at head that passes at base; the head suite is 255 passed against 260 passed at base after the intended retirement of five cases. added_failure_count=0.

findings.text: NEO4J_URI no longer bypasses an unreadable location configuration: the deleted _resolve_graph_uri returned os.environ['NEO4J_URI'] before it touched anything else, whereas the new body calls get_graph_uri() -> resolve_neo4j(), which calls resolve_location() at profiles.py:399 before it applies the env escape hatch at profiles.py:424. Measured by the reviewer: with get_graph_location pinned to titan, resolve_location forced to raise, and NEO4J_URI=bolt://example.invalid:1 set, _resolve_graph_uri() raised RuntimeError('location config unreadable') instead of returning the explicit URI. The documented escape hatch therefore no longer survives a broken location config as it did before the change. It does not block this node, whose done-when deliberately keeps the raise, and NEO4J_URI still wins whenever the location reads.

Record observation, not a code defect: the reviewed manifest omits tests/remote/test_locations_resolution.py from orientation_write_paths even though the diff edits it; the path is authorised in the resume advice, but a reader of the manifest alone cannot see the widened scope without also reading the resume stream.
